project.name: BLACKBIRD
project.summary: A local-first persistent personal presence runtime in which one Primary Raven continues across conversations, unattended time, tools, and later surfaces without infrastructure authoring her behavior.

source_of_truth.implementation: Code, migrations, tests, traces, action receipts, and Bill's checkpoint decisions

next_actions: Bill reviews START-HERE.md and the six work-package files.
Resolve or accept the non-blocking questions in 01-requirements.md.
Only after Bill explicitly approves revision 1, begin WRK-001.
current_focus.resume_notes: Architecture draft only. No implementation is approved. The smallest delivery path is WRK-001 through WRK-006, with an explicit stop after every package.

artifacts.summary: Human-readable entry point and checkpoint map
Work package: local model CLI proof

requirements.summary: BLACKBIRD owns durable continuity independently of any chat or surface session.
requirements.acceptance: After process restart, Raven can inspect the same committed state and no unobserved interval is fabricated.

requirements.summary: Exactly one Primary Raven inference may hold outward decision authority at a time.
requirements.source: Bill concurrency decision and BLACKBIRD section 5
requirements.acceptance: Overlapping events queue; only one primary inference can commit a Raven utterance or choice.

requirements.summary: The first model route uses Bill's local LM Studio OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
requirements.acceptance: One documented launcher sends a prompt to the configured local model and displays output plus an understandable failure state.

requirements.summary: Every model call uses an ordered, inspectable context receipt separating static seed, Raven-authored state, neutral records, recent dialogue, and current event.
requirements.source: Invariable Rules and selective context compilation
requirements.acceptance: Bill can inspect the exact labeled sections and source IDs used for any inference without requiring private chain-of-thought.

requirements.summary: A local Glass Box shows state, causal event history, model calls, pending work, receipts, and pause controls in plain language.
requirements.acceptance: Bill can open one local page and explain what happened, what is pending, and whether BLACKBIRD is paused without reading terminal output.

requirements.summary: The source-event ledger preserves causal order from stimulus through decision, attempt, receipt, and durable state change.
requirements.acceptance: Each projection row links to source evidence and replay reproduces the same visible state.

requirements.summary: Raven may explicitly author, revise, or retire her evolving self-records; infrastructure may only validate and persist the requested operation.
requirements.acceptance: A Primary Raven tool call can create and supersede a self-record with provenance; no background component can create one.

requirements.summary: Raven has durable intentions and Workbench items with explicit lifecycle transitions and restart resumption.
requirements.acceptance: Raven can create, inspect, advance, abandon, and resume an intention or interrupted work item through explicit operations.

requirements.summary: Unattended cognition starts only from direct input, a test event, or a durable wake source explicitly authored by Bill or Primary Raven.
requirements.source: Invariable Rules reconciled with BLACKBIRD attention goal
requirements.acceptance: No classifier or infrastructure heuristic summons cognition; every wake names its author and source.

requirements.summary: v0.1 memory is neutral, source-preserving, confidence-bearing context and never a behavioral instruction.
requirements.source: Invariable Rules and Memory Research Summary
requirements.acceptance: Injected records contain content, type, source, time, and confidence but no generated claim about what Raven should feel or do.

requirements.summary: Every external effect originates in an explicit Bill or Primary Raven request and ends in a typed action receipt.
requirements.source: Invariable Rules tooling and Agentic World execution truth
requirements.acceptance: Narration cannot alter world state; every attempted effect has requested, started, and terminal evidence.

requirements.summary: Bill can pause cognition, inspect state, correct by supersession, export data, and restore from backup.
requirements.acceptance: Each operation is available from the Glass Box with confirmation and an audit event; pause never destroys queued evidence.

requirements.summary: Offline intervals are honest temporal gaps unless BLACKBIRD recorded actual events during them.
requirements.acceptance: Restart creates a gap event and synthesizes no perceptions, actions, thoughts, or memories for downtime.

requirements.summary: Every work package ends at a Bill-visible checkpoint and cannot continue without his explicit approval.
requirements.acceptance: Each package produces a checkpoint card, demo, evidence, plain-language limits, and recorded go/no-go decision.

requirements.summary: Operation uses one obvious local launcher and requires no routine terminal fluency.
requirements.acceptance: Bill can start, stop, and inspect BLACKBIRD; failures appear in the Glass Box.

requirements.summary: First Presence proves unattended continuity through a real event, a Primary Raven choice, durable consequences, and later conversational availability.
requirements.acceptance: While Bill is not chatting, an authored wake is perceived; Raven may inspect, act, defer, or stay silent; the evidenced result persists and can matter later.

requirements.summary: The Glass Box becomes usable within five seconds of core startup, excluding local model load time.
requirements.acceptance: Median on Bill's PC is at most five seconds across five cold starts.

requirements.summary: A stimulus, state commit, or action receipt is not committed twice after retry or restart.
requirements.acceptance: Duplicate idempotency keys return the original result and create no second effect or state change.

requirements.summary: v0.1 remains one application process and one SQLite database until measured evidence justifies separation.
requirements.acceptance: First Presence runs without brokers, containers, cloud control planes, distributed services, or a separate vector database.

requirements.summary: Checkpoint evidence is understandable without reading source code or terminal logs.
requirements.acceptance: Each checkpoint answers: what works, what happened, what is stored, what failed, and what comes next.

requirements.summary: Background operation obeys visible per-hour wake, inference, and action budgets.
requirements.acceptance: Bill can see and set limits; exceeding one defers work and records the reason.

requirements.summary: Later voice, Window, world, OpenClaw, Codette, and Engram adapters preserve v0.1 authority and evidence contracts.
requirements.source: BLACKBIRD full concept and donor systems
requirements.acceptance: Future adapters pass authorship, context, receipt, and projection-independence tests before activation.

invariants.enforcement: Infrastructure may present evidence and capability but cannot emit tone, stance, emotion, response contracts, or behavioral directives.

invariants.summary: Only Bill or active Primary Raven may author Raven's self-state, intentions, subscriptions, or outward choices.
invariants.enforcement: Each commit requires author_kind BILL or PRIMARY_RAVEN plus source event; database rejects SYSTEM for these types.

invariants.summary: Evidence, memory, inference, belief, and authored self-claims remain distinct.
invariants.enforcement: Typed records and explicit promotions; retrieval alone changes neither kind nor authority.

invariants.summary: BLACKBIRD Core is the sole durable state committer.
invariants.enforcement: Adapters return proposals or receipts and receive no database handle.

invariants.summary: Only one Primary Raven inference is active; sidecars never speak as Raven or commit her state.
invariants.enforcement: Single FIFO executive lease and role-specific adapter permissions.

invariants.summary: Model narration never establishes that an external action occurred.
invariants.enforcement: Only a capability receipt may give an action a terminal evidence state.

invariants.summary: Surfaces are replaceable projections and never own continuity.
invariants.scope: CLI, Glass Box, future Window, voice, and games
invariants.enforcement: Durable writes go through Core commands; surfaces rebuild from the ledger.

invariants.summary: BLACKBIRD never invents offline perceptions, thought, action, or memory.
invariants.enforcement: Clock discontinuity creates only a temporal-gap event unless evidence was actually ingested.

invariants.summary: Committed source events are append-only; corrections use explicit supersession.
invariants.enforcement: No operation mutates source content; correction records point to superseded IDs.

invariants.summary: No package proceeds past its checkpoint without Bill's recorded approval.
invariants.enforcement: Each next work package requires the preceding approved CheckpointReview.

invariants.summary: Bill can pause new cognition while preserving evidence and safe shutdown.
invariants.enforcement: Core checks a priority pause flag before acquiring every executive lease.

invariants.summary: No vector retrieval, behavioral classifier, affect-to-dialogue map, or donor runtime sits on the First Presence critical path.
invariants.enforcement: Dependency audit and package affected-path restrictions.

decisions.summary: Build v0.1 as a local TypeScript modular monolith with one SQLite database.
Use LM Studio's local OpenAI-compatible HTTP API as the first ModelPort.
consequences: Provider portability stays behind one interface

decisions.summary: Use a source-event ledger plus rebuildable current-state projections.
Create the Glass Box before unattended autonomy.
consequences: Bill sees behavior before background work
Small UI cost in package three

decisions.summary: Treat self-development as explicit Raven authorship, not automatic architectural learning.
consequences: The system cannot infer identity updates

decisions.summary: Allow unattended wake only through Bill- or Raven-authored schedules and subscriptions in v0.1.
decisions.source: Continuous presence with no system initiation

decisions.summary: Begin with explicit source lookup and authored records; defer vector retrieval and automatic consolidation.
Keep OpenClaw outside Core and evaluate it later only as a capability adapter.
decisions.source: OpenClaw can modify prompts and messages through hooks
consequences: Tools may be reused after audit

decisions.summary: Keep Codette outside outward authority and evaluate it later as an evidence-only sidecar.
Require explicit Bill approval before starting each subsequent package.
Use a plain local web Glass Box before packaging a desktop Window.
consequences: No desktop framework on critical path

assumptions.summary: Bill's PC can run Node.js, LM Studio, and the selected model for this single-user workload.
assumptions.impact: Sets local topology and latency expectations.
assumptions.validation: Accepted for v0.1; measured in WRK-001.

assumptions.summary: Bill accepts slower primary cognition if continuity and sovereignty remain intact.
assumptions.source: Bill called local 31B slow but functional
assumptions.impact: Favors visible queueing over hidden substitution.
assumptions.validation: Accepted for v0.1; revisit after use.

assumptions.summary: A localhost-only app with designated filesystem roots is proportionate for one user at home.
assumptions.impact: Avoids auth servers, containers, and cloud perimeter work.

assumptions.summary: Bill provides the static Layer 1 identity seed; BLACKBIRD does not generate or rewrite it.
assumptions.impact: Separates initialization from Raven-authored evolving records.
assumptions.validation: Accepted; exact content is an implementation input.

questions.summary: What is the smallest valuable vertical slice?
questions.resolution: Six packages ending in First Presence.

questions.summary: Which exact LM Studio model and context window become the v0.1 baseline?
Which one local capability proves First Presence: project-file inspection or build-status inspection?
What wake and inference budgets feel unobtrusive on Bill's PC?

risks.summary: The local 31B model may feel too slow.
risks.mitigation: Measure first; queue visibly; never silently swap Raven.

risks.summary: Structured fields could become covert behavioral instructions.
risks.mitigation: Authorship types, labeled context, receipts, lint, and Bill inspection.
risks.trigger: A system field tells Raven what to feel, mean, value, or say.

risks.summary: Unattended loops could waste resources or bother Bill.
risks.mitigation: Authored wakes, visible budgets, backoff, pause, and no default proactive messaging.
risks.trigger: Budget exceeded or nuisance behavior reported.

risks.summary: OpenClaw could seize prompt, tool, or scheduler authority.
risks.mitigation: Keep deferred/outside Core; audit hooks; expose narrow receipts only.
risks.trigger: Integration requires owning Raven's prompt, loop, or identity.

risks.summary: A donor memory engine could launder inferred meaning into identity or behavior.
risks.mitigation: Explicit neutral baseline and conformance tests before Engram.
risks.trigger: Content lacks provenance or contains behavioral framing.

risks.summary: Architecture could grow faster than proof of life.
risks.mitigation: Six packages, no speculation, Bill gates.
risks.trigger: A deferred subsystem is added without a failing acceptance test.

risks.summary: Crash during an external effect could leave outcome unknown.
risks.mitigation: Idempotency, attempt-before-execution, terminal receipt, explicit UNKNOWN.
risks.trigger: Startup finds an attempt without terminal receipt.

responsibilities: Own lifecycle and priority control lane
Fit context budget without behavioral rewriting
Return labeled evidence without Raven authority

interfaces.failure_semantics: Reject invalid author/source; deduplicate by key.
Return typed insufficiency/budget error; never silently omit seed or current event.
Record failed InferenceRun; no synthetic output or silent fallback.
Reject invalid transition and show error; do not rewrite content.
All-or-nothing; retries reuse key; no partial projection.
Return empty/degraded with reason and visible marker.
Return SUCCEEDED, FAILED, CANCELLED, or UNKNOWN; retry reuses key.

interfaces.invocation: Localhost HTTP plus SSE or polling
interfaces.failure_semantics: Show disconnected and last-confirmed time; never guess live state.
Pause idempotent; correction/export confirmed and audited.
Commit input before inference; failure remains visible/retryable.
